prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1059; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the claimant in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in what appears to have been a low-speed head-on impact, and we are now handling all aspects of the claim on their behalf.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any contact with the claimant should be routed through our firm.

We request that you disclose the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured for this loss, along with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, total loss valuations, and any other material in your possession or control.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your agreement to these requests.
